en: A colorized historical postcard showing a town square with a war memorial monument in the center, surrounded by cobblestone streets and well-preserved buildings with shopfronts. The buildings have German-language signage, and people can be seen walking on the sidewalks. The name 'Lommatzsch' is written at the top, and more German text is present, including references to a street and a war memorial.
